definitions.explanation: A secondary residence used for holidays or retreats, typically located in the countryside, mountains, or by the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別荘|べっそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a vacation home in Karuizawa.
In summer, I go to the vacation home with my family.

notes:
{別荘|べっそう} is a secondary residence used for vacations and retreats, typically in scenic locations like mountains, coastlines, or hot spring areas.

FORMS:
⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate) + {荘|そう} (villa, manor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別荘|べっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: to build a vacation home
- {別荘|べっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧: to rent a villa
- {別荘|べっそう}{地|ち}: resort area, vacation home district
- {別荘|べっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to own a vacation home

CULTURAL NOTE:
Owning a {別荘|べっそう} has traditionally been associated with wealth. Popular areas include ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧ (Karuizawa), ⟦{箱根|はこね}→箱根：30712_hakone⟧ (Hakone), and {那須|なす} (Nasu). In recent years, remote work has renewed interest in countryside properties as semi-permanent residences.

SIMILAR WORDS:
{別荘|べっそう} is a private vacation home. For rental accommodations, {貸|かし}{別荘|べっそう} (rental villa) or ⟦ペンション→ペンション：15998_penshon⟧ (pension/lodge) are used.
